photo.caption: Panoramic view of the Kumaon Himalaya as seen from Ranikhet in the northern Indian state of Uttarakhand. Himalayan giants such as Trisul (7,120 m (23,360 ft)), Nanda Devi (7,817 m (25,646 ft)), Nanda Kot (6,861 m (22,510 ft)), Panchachuli (6,904 m (22,651 ft)) and other peaks are prominently visible.
